slides.text: Impartation Service
The last days are the groundbreaking days of the church of Christ

Acts 3:20-21 And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you: whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
Matthew 11:11 Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
The end-time saints are ordained to be groundbreaking saints
Prophetic characteristics of the end-time church
Joel 2:1-11
Joel 2:2 A great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
Generational groundbreakers
Joel 2:3 A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness
Don't be driven by the economy of the world. You have access to His riches in glory.
Their greatness is supernatural: the hand of God lifting them to unimaginable heights
A church of unchecked affluence
Daniel 11:32 The people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
Health and vitality
An army of visionaries: they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks
When they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded: divinely guarded, divinely protected
There is room for everyone on top. No one needs to come down for you to go up.
Unchecked access to secrets: they shall enter in at the windows like a thief
Zechariah 8:23 Ten men shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
Joel 2:11 And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word
An unstoppable agenda: if you can't stop the sun and the moon, you can't stop God's agenda
Acts 2:16-17 This is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel; And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh
Between now and 2026, a proven release of this army
Prayer: Lord, help me to secure my place in this army
In summary: a generational record-breaking army
1. Operating with explosive, life-revolutionizing revelation
Habakkuk 2:14 For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
Jeremiah 31:34 And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them
Isaiah 60:22 A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
Isaiah 60:1-3 Arise, shine; for thy light is come. And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
2. Untiring word lovers
3. A supernatural global impact church
You need a meek spirit to secure your place
Isaiah 2:3 And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths
4. A church endowed with supernatural wealth
Haggai 2:8-9 The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts. The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former

Job 22:21-26 Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace. If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up. Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust. Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
A church of strange financial fortune, without games, without gimmicks
Psalm 78:69 And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
5. The enthronement of the end-time church
Psalm 110:1-3 Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool. Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
Between now and next year, several enthroned individuals
Daniel 2:44 In the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed
6. Days of the manifold wisdom of God on display

Ephesians 3:8-11 To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God, according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord
Matthew 13:54 Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
Proverbs 3:19 The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
Psalm 104:24 O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
God's institutions on the earth will be solution-providing institutions
Romans 8:19 For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
Exodus 4:17 And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
Genuine love for God is our unlimited access to the secrets of God

John 15:15 Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

1 Corinthians 2:9-10 Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him. But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
Burning love for God is fundamental to being enlisted in this army
The last days are days to watch
Matthew 24:12 And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
Freelance Christianity will disqualify you
2 Timothy 3:1-5 For men shall be lovers of their own selves, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God; having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
2 Thessalonians 2:7 For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
3 John 1:2 Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
Luke 18:8 Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
Keep your faith away from faith destroyers
Faith is a universal currency: it holds the same value in all nations of the earth
Faith is not fake. Faith is real.
Man can only take you to where his hand can reach, but the everlasting arm of God takes you to everlasting heights
Love is a choice, not a gift. But the choice requires empowerment for sustenance.
Matthew 26:33-35 Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended. Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee.
Acts 4:13 Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
Romans 5:5 The love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
2 Corinthians 5:17 If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
